description: Fetch a single comment with its replies + reactions in one round trip. Pass any comment id in the thread (root or reply). Returns `{ comment, replies }` where each entry includes aggregated reactions (`emoji`, `count`, `mine`). Use this when an agent receives a `comment.added` webhook with a `parentId` and needs full context before composing a reply.

comment_id.description: Comment id (any node in the thread).

name: get_comment_thread
